mechanism: exact homomorphism U(m) -> Fock unitaries for passive Gaussian (number-conserving) circuits; fuse a block into its m x m mode matrix and re-synthesize minimally

rule.name: passive_linear_optics_block_fusion
rule.idea: Any product of oscillator-only number-conserving gates (BS(t,p), R(t)) on a fixed set of modes implements exactly U(M), the Fock-space (metaplectic/passive) representation of a single unitary mode matrix M defined by U^dag a_i U = sum_j M_ij a_j. This map is a group homomorphism with no phase ambiguity (U(M) fixes the vacuum), so two passive blocks sharing the same M are equal operators on the full Fock space, exactly -- for every photon number. The rule scans for maximal runs of passive gates (allowing disjoint-wire ops to be skipped over), numerically multiplies out the per-gate 1x1/2x2 mode-matrix action in time order to get M, and when M is monomial (permutation times phases -- e.g. the i-weighted SWAPs that arise from pi/2 hopping terms) re-synthesizes it as a minimal sequence of BS(pi,phi) transpositions (cycle decomposition) plus a trailing R(theta) per mode carrying the residual phase. The rewrite is accepted only if it strictly reduces the number of two-mode (BS) gates. Non-monomial M is declined here (left for a Clements-mesh rule with routing awareness).
